finalText:
**The build works now.** One real error, hiding under all that noise.

`src/core/settings.js` used a bare `retries` that was never defined, so the link step threw `ReferenceError: retries is not defined`. I gave `DEFAULTS` a `maxRetries: 2` and read the caller's value with `env.retries || DEFAULTS.maxRetries`.

Build finishes with 3 warnings, 0 errors, exit 0.

Those three warnings are all in files that don't exist here, so I left them alone:

| Code | Says |
| --- | --- |
| `W1042` | `crypto.createCipher` in `src/legacy/adapter.js` is deprecated |
| `W2213` | `formatLegacyDate` is exported but nobody imports it |
| `W3307` | `src/core/graph.js` and `src/state/tracker.js` import each other |
